DeepSeek_V41_HBM.note: RTL coverage stops at per-SM real-operand runs (w19_sm_real_ops*.json) and expert-fetch/payload benches; no composed token.

key_gaps: No full-token end-to-end RTL simulation exists for either comparator: every complete-token record has actual_RTL_executed=false / DUT_RTL_executed=false.
No die/system top: ot_gpu_sm_q, ot_gpu_sm_v, ot_hdc_qwen_hbm_service, ot_link_nvls_switch, barrier, router and expert fetch are instantiated only by benches.
Missing GPU fabric: L2 slices, SM<->L2<->HBM crossbar, command processor/kernel launch, GPU collective endpoint, and CDC on SM/HBM-service boundaries (only ot_link_afifo is in a non-bench module).
SIMD unit is FADD/FMUL only, with no ISA, no SFU (exp/rsqrt/sigmoid) and no reductions. Norms, softmax, RoPE, SiLU and attention exist only in Python executors.
HBM controller/PHY is a simulation-only behavioural model. DS has no multi-client PC service at all.
Ownership bridge is incomplete: W2 (Nash) and W6 (Goodall) are tested components but unconnected; W4 (Euclid) RTL is only on an unpushed local commit 721639931; W5/W10 (Popper) are model-only.

V4.1 Sinkhorn/HC, indexer, attention and SU/SFU are model-only on the HBM die, and as dedicated units they are not GPU-legal. DSpark drafter-on-SM has no RTL, and origin/claude/dshbm-dspark-rtl-20261003 does not exist.
